dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hear it for the "Tanuki of the Chinju Forest."

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: That remains true for the tanuki of the Chinju Forest. They're not evil monsters, but they do enjoy playing tricks on people.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Saiguu noticed this and began matching wits with the tanuki. She came out on top, of course, leaving them razzled and dazzled, stumped and stymied on many an occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: After Saiguu mysteriously disappeared, the tanuki grew bored, having lost their competitor and playmate, and turned to pulling pranks on villagers who pass by.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Do be careful if a pretty little house, delicious food, or golden Mora ever suddenly appear before you while you're in the mountain forest.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Because before you know it, the treasures would've become dirt, and ah! You'd realize that you've fallen for their tanuki tricks all too late...
